title: Daivasura Sampad Vibhaga Yoga
translation: The Yoga of the Division between Divine and Demoniac Qualities
summary: Krishna contrasts divine qualities that lead to liberation with demoniac qualities that lead to bondage, and urges Arjuna to follow the guidance of the scriptures.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः |
दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम् || १ ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: Fearlessness; purification of one's existence; cultivation of spiritual knowledge; charity; self-control; performance of sacrifice; study of the Vedas; austerity; simplicity...
verses.transliteration:
śrī-bhagavān uvāca
abhayaṁ sattva-saṁśuddhir jñāna-yoga-vyavasthitiḥ
dānaṁ damaś ca yajñaś ca svādhyāyas tapa ārjavam
verses.meaning: Abhayam - fearlessness; Sattva-samshuddhih - purification of existence...
